title: How to Get the Best Price for Your South Tampa Home
topic: How to get the best price for your South Tampa home
gbp_post:
Most South Tampa sellers focus on the wrong number. They fixate on list price when the number that actually matters is net proceeds — what lands in your account after concessions, repairs, and carrying costs eat into the headline figure.

Homes in Palma Ceia, Hyde Park, and Davis Islands that sell closest to or above asking price share a pattern: they entered the market priced within 2-3% of recent comparable sales, were in move-in condition before photos were taken, and hit the MLS on a Wednesday or Thursday to capture the full weekend buyer pool.

Pricing above market to leave room to negotiate sounds logical. The data says otherwise. In South Tampa, overpriced listings that require a price reduction sell for less than homes priced accurately from day one. Buyers discount a listing the moment they see a reduction — they assume something is wrong.

The first ten days on market are the highest-leverage window a seller gets. Showings, offers, and online views are densest in that window. A home that sits past day 21 is fighting a perception battle no price cut fully wins.

The difference between a good sale and a great one usually comes down to decisions made before the sign goes in the yard. That reality shows up in the data every time.
